name: Papa's Taco Mia

comments.author: CosmicKraken99
comments.content: OMG, Papa's Taco Mia is the best! So many ingredients, I can make any taco! What a blast!

comments.author: SavageKatana_X
comments.content: Chicken, beef... all the usual suspects. Wish they had more exotic meats, though. Still, fun game.

comments.author: Witcher4Lyfe
comments.content: Seriously addicted! The soft shell tacos are my jam. I can't stop playing this one!

comments.author: NoobMaster9000
comments.content: Is it just me, or is managing the onions a real challenge? Still, worth it for those delicious tacos!

comments.author: xX_DarkAura_Xx
comments.content: Papa's Taco Mia lets you get creative with different ingredients. I'm loving the hard shell tacos!

comments.author: PhantomPhoenix42

comments.author: AdjectiveRevolver_V
comments.content: Wish there were more sides to serve, tbh. But making tacos is pretty fun. Try it out!

comments.author: GamerOver9000
comments.content: The onions and peppers combo is fire, for serious. Such a great game. Highly recommend.

comments.author: LagWarriorXX

comments.author: StalkingLeviathan87
comments.content: The soft and hard shell tacos are quite the selection. It's the little things that count, right?

userInputText: Have you ever wanted to run your own taqueria? Well, now you can with Papa's Taco Mia! They have all the ingredients you could ever want - beef, chicken, onions, peppers, hard shell and soft shell tacos. You can make any kind of taco you desire.
